text_span.text: "I do. Father's letter was clear. Something is wrong at the Silver Gate, and no one else will go."
"The Silver Gate is a myth. Father chased myths his whole life, and look where it got him."
"I'll be back before the winter solstice. I promise."
"Then you'll want to avoid the Thornwood after dark. Things move in those trees that don't have names."
"Your father passed through here, you know. Three months ago. Asked about the old road."
"Did he say where he was going?"
"Said he was looking for something that was lost. Said it like a man who'd already found it and wished he hadn't."
"Be careful, girl. The north remembers what the south forgets."
"The Gate is not a door. It is a question. And the answer changes depending on who asks."
